text: In portions of the frequency spectrum that are licensed. That means that if a mobile operator wants to provide service to its own users, he can do that by using frequency portions for which it has paid. Every mobile operator pays to use certain portions of the frequency spectrum, and in this way he gets a license to operate in those frequency portions. Okay, so they are called licensed frequencies. So in this case, the mobile operator needs frequencies to serve the users. He needs to pay for the frequencies. It pays the Ministry of Telecommunication. But in this way, as we said, he can provide services to its own users, and the users, of course, pay the subscription. So the mobile operator needs to pay for the frequencies on the one hand, but on the other hand, he gets revenues from the subscribers. Okay, the more subscribers you get, of course, the higher the revenue. So once the mobile operator has paid the license to use certain frequencies, then it is in the mobile operator interest to increase the number of users or subscribers he can serve. Okay, to maximize in so in so.
